messages:
maia: quick follow-up on rollout metadata — proposal to add a compact 'fallback_history' field so the runtime can autonomously revert to a previously known-good variant without contacting control plane. low-traffic ops mode, not always-on. thoughts?
kevin: sounds useful. my take: make it a ring buffer of entries (variant_id|reason|ts|compat_tags). store as a base64 compressed blob to keep per-request headers tiny. runtime can decode on error/backoff.
lena: ops concern: if it's blob-only, observability suffers. can we also publish an 'ops_index' with the last N entries in a plain JSON list for searchable logs?
hari: compatibility semantics question — when runtime picks from history, should it require interface_version match or only architecture-level compat? recommend two gates: interface_version must match, then fall back to arch-compat if interface absent.
sam: from an ML perspective we should also record a small scalar (probe_metric) and probe_prompt_id per entry so we can quickly see if the fallback correlates with quality regressions. otherwise auto-reverting might hide regressions.
kevin: example compact lines i'm thinking of (pseudo):
```
# fallback_history (string blob when decoded):
v123|perf-drop|1690000000|iface:2
v119|safety|1690000123|iface:2
```
lena: @kevin if you go blob + ops_index, add a transform job that extracts the ops_index into control-plane index for retention/querying. retention defaults: 10 entries, 30d TTL.
ops-bot: retention-job-scheduler: noted. ops index extraction job scheduled nightly; retention 30d for ops_index unless overridden. :gear:
hari: also think about cross-tenant/private deployments — history may leak model provenance (tenant A fallback shows variant owned by vendor B). add a 'visibility' enum per entry: public | tenant-only | redacted. default tenant-only.
kevin: implementation note: parsing the blob in hot-path adds ~1.2ms if checked per-request. suggestion: runtime consults fallback_history only on error windows or when latency/capacity triggers, not on every request.
maia: actionable summary: 1) kevin to draft mini-RFC with sample payload formats + perf microbench, 2) lena to spec ops_index extraction + retention + query API, 3) sam to propose probe_metric thresholds for auto-revert suppression. please ack and i'll schedule a 30m follow-up in 48h.
kevin: 👍 starting a PR with serializer + decode tests today.
